media.title: The Codex-assisted F0X port running natively on Apple platforms

title: Port a Native Game Stack to Apple Platforms with Codex
summary: Kahris describes using Codex to bring an existing native game stack to ARM64 Mac, iPhone, and iPad targets, including app bundles, Apple filesystem and lifecycle fixes, and on-device data extraction, then testing the result on real hardware. An iOS team can keep a proven core runtime intact while isolating the platform integration work.
takeaway: Separate the Apple-specific targets, lifecycle, filesystem, input, and packaging work from the upstream runtime, then validate the port on each physical device class.
